properties.source: sale | ledger | audit | bulk | return | mutation
properties.at: stored event timestamp or null when unavailable
properties.actor_username: immutable acting-account username snapshot or null when unavailable
properties.subject: immutable historical subject label or null
properties.metadata: absent except for the closed customer contact fact described below

change.rule: Emit only a directly changed field. Omit equal before/after states. Sale creation emits its fixed captured field set from known_none to its captured state. The sole empty-changes exception is customer_contact_changed with valid changed_contact_fields metadata.

customer_contact_changed_metadata.changed_contact_fields: unique non-empty array drawn only from phone|address, maximum 2

historical_rules: General customer_id null is known_none, never unknown.
An absent legacy customer or membership snapshot is unknown, never fabricated from the current contact.
Customer, membership, driver, item and actor labels are write-time snapshots and are never resolved through mutable current rows.
Customer Records retain only stable id and display name. They do not add immutable phone or address copies; full contact data remains on authorized sale details.

A customer phone/address carry is customer_contact_changed with changed_contact_fields metadata only. Phone/address values and fabricated before/after booleans are forbidden. If the same act also changes customer identity/name or membership, use customer_changed with the real changed fields and attach the same bounded metadata.
A genuine historical sale event that cannot be mapped narrowly is legacy_sale_change with changes=[]; render Earlier sale change and historical details unavailable without raw variables.
Rows sharing one replacement group_id and direction form one items_replaced record.
Durable receipt generation preserves one original record and every Undo/Redo record even after ordinary audit pruning; unavailable replay actor/time stay null and provenance_unknown=true.
Records detail length and list-row records_count must remain equal.
